description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Finance Manager to oversee our financial operations and contribute to the strategic financial management of the company. The Finance Manager will be responsible for providing insightful financial guidance and analysis to support decision-making processes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and optimizing financial performance. 

 

Job Responsibilities 

  • Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A):
    • Develop and maintain financial models to forecast company performance, including budgeting, variance analysis, and scenario planning.
    • Analyze financial data and trends to provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic planning and decision-making.
    • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial metrics to assess business performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Financial Reporting and Compliance:
    • Prepare and oversee the timely and accurate preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, in accordance with regulatory requirements and accounting standards.
    • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and accounting principles.
    • Coordinate external audits and regulatory filings, liaising with auditors and regulatory authorities as necessary. 3. Risk Management:
    • Identify and assess financial risks and opportunities, developing strategies to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities. 

    • Implement and maintain effective internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures. 

       

Job Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; Master's degree or professional certification (e.g., CPA, ACCA) preferred.
  • Knowledge & experience in using SQL Accounting System is an added advantage. - In-depth knowledge of financial principles, regulations, and best practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and trends.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling and analysis tools, as well as MS Office suite (particularly Excel and PowerPoint).
  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and integrity.
  • Must love to work in a high growth startup environment.
  • Must have high sense of responsibility & accountability.
  • Positive attitude with good communication skills.
  • Able to work under pressure to meet tight deadline.
  • Able to work with minimal supervision. 

Ready to join the team? Send your resume to admin@nurengroup.com with the subject ‘Job Application: Finance Manager / Head of Finance - [Your Full Name]’.

Job Requirements:

Ready to join the team? Send your resume to admin@nurengroup.com with the subject ‘Job Application: Content Creator (TikTok, Instagram, XiaoHongShu platforms) - [Your Full Name]’.

Job Responsibilities: 

  • Craft Engaging Content: Roll up your sleeves and dive into the creative process! You'll not only edit and proofread but also write captivating content across various formats, from articles to video scripts and copywriting.
  • Sub-edit and Proofread: You'll be the guardian of grammar and syntax, ensuring our content sparkles like prose poetry.
  • Adhere to House Style: You'll ensure every comma is in its place and every 'z' is swapped for an 's', because in our world, it's all about British English.
  • Source Stellar Images: You'll scour the digital cosmos for the perfect visuals to accompany our stellar stories, ensuring our portal is always picture-perfect.
  • Sponsored Content Star: From planning to execution, you'll be our go-to guru for sponsored and branded content, weaving magic into every collaboration to create engaging narratives that resonate with our audience.
  • Expand Content and Readership: Got a brilliant idea for a story? Pitch IT! You'll help us brainstorm and execute content that keeps our readers coming back for more.
  • SEO Savvy: Know your way around keywords? Great! You'll sprinkle some SEO magic on our articles to help them shine in the vast online galaxy.
  • Consumer Insights Connoisseur: Dive deep into the minds of our audience, especially in the female, moms, and kids space, to understand their behavior and preferences, shaping our content strategy accordingly.
  • Miscellaneous Marvels: From ad-hoc assignments to rewriting copy, you'll be our go-to for all things editorial. 

Job Requirements: 

  • Experience: You've got at least 3 years under your belt, ideally in the world of content creation or editorial wizardry, with prior experience in advertising, media, or creative agency being a plus.
  • Writing Wizardry: You possess an effective writing style that's fresh, consistent, and customer-friendly, with a knack for editing, proofreading, and conducting thorough research.
  • Branded Content Brilliance: You've got experience with sponsored and branded content, from planning to execution, and you know how to create narratives that resonate with our audience.
  • Language Lover: Fluent in the Queen's English, you're a stickler for spelling and grammar, catching errors with the precision of a laser-guided comma detector.
  • Educational Extras: A degree in Journalism, Media, or English is preferred, but if you've got the skills, we're all ears.
  • Multitasking Maven: Juggling deadlines is your jam. You can handle multiple tasks with ease, all while keeping your cool.
  • Meticulous and Detail-Oriented: A sharp eye for detail – you spot typos faster than a speeding semicolon.
  • SEO Savvy: You have a basic understanding of SEO, keywords and meta tags, and are able to craft SEO-optimised content that shines online.
  • Positive Attitude: A can-do spirit, a result-driven mindset, and a flexible personality are key traits we're looking for.
  • Parental Potential: Bonus points for parents – you know first-hand the struggles (and joys!) we write about. ‍‍
  • Communication Champ: Excellent communication, people skills, and networking abilities are a must-have.
  • Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment, with stellar communication skills to match.
  • Startup Enthusiast: You're excited about working in a high-growth startup environment, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities for growth.

Job Description: 

 

Event Planning & Execution

  • Plan, organize, and execute Super Kids Club events ensuring they align with our brand’s vision and provide a positive, memorable experience for families.
  • Coordinate event logistics, including venue booking, equipment, activities, participants lists, and event timelines.
  • Collaborate with creative and design teams to develop event marketing materials (invitations, posters, social media assets, etc.).
  • Conduct post-event evaluations to gather feedback, assess event success, and recommend improvements for future events.

Marketing & Content Development

  • Work closely with the marketing team to create event-specific promotional content, including social media posts and email newsletters.
  • Develop strategies to increase Super Kids Club memberships and engagement through targeted campaigns and offers.
  • Monitor and analyze engagement metrics for Super Kids Club campaigns and events to identify areas for optimization.
  • Collaborate with influencers, bloggers, and community groups to increase event exposure and attract target audiences.

Customer Engagement & Experience

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with parents and families attending Super Kids Club events, ensuring a high standard of customer service.
  • Respond to inquiries, feedback, and concerns promptly to foster a welcoming and supportive community.
  • Gather customer insights to refine event offerings, adjust to changing trends, and continuously improve member satisfaction.

Operations & Logistics Support

  • Assist with coordination and general logistics for internal events and online classes, including managing inventory, vendor coordination, and transportation.
  • Support the team in maintaining event supplies, tracking materials, and managing any ad-hoc operational tasks.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure all operational aspects are aligned and support the smooth delivery of all events.

Administrative & Reporting

  • Track event / online classes budgets and ensure expenses align with financial goals.
  • Prepare reports on event performance, marketing initiatives, and campaign ROI.
  • Provide administrative support as needed, including scheduling, documentation, and report preparation.

 

Job Requirement:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Event Management, Communications, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience in event planning, marketing, or a related role, ideally within the motherhood, parenting, or children’s events space.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, meet deadlines and KPI.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a knack for engaging storytelling.
  • Experience with social media platforms, digital marketing tools, and CRM systems is a plus.
  • High level of creativity and attention to detail.
  • Up-to-date with the latest trends and marketing best practices. 

 

Ready to join the team? Send your resume to racheal.alan@nurengroup.com with the subject ‘Job Application: Marketing Executive (Events & Community) - [Your Full Name]’.
